title: Phone carousel
description: Three phones open from a stack, then slide one slot left twice so each of three app screens takes the centre, and the hero settles. 5 s, silent, 9:16.

slots.name: screens
slots.note: Three app screenshots from the library (portrait, about 9:19.5), as a list of asset names in the order they take the centre.

slots.name: background
slots.note: The field; a light neutral keeps the phones' shadows readable.

beats.say: Three phones open from a stack.
beats.visual: Three phones open from a stack: the side phones fan out from behind the hero.

beats.say: The carousel slides to the second screen.
beats.visual: The carousel slides one slot left; the second screen takes the centre.
It slides again; the third screen takes the centre.

beats.say: The hero settles in the centre.
beats.visual: The hero phone settles in the centre with a soft shadow.
